description: Find public notifying organisations by name substring in the Washington, Delaware and California Attorney General breach-notice lists. Returns notice IDs and counts separately for each state, plus any paired Washington and Delaware notices whose notice dates are within three days. When paired discovery dates differ, the two states' records carry different dates; neither date is declared correct. Withheld names are excluded from this index and never returned or searchable. A non-match in these three states' records never means no breach: list coverage, reporting thresholds and organisation names vary. The notifying organisation may differ from the breached one.

organization.description: Required case-insensitive public organization name substring, at most 80 characters; absence does not mean no breach.

name: breach_notice_organization
title: Find Breach Notices by Organization
